name: simple-lock
description: Custom Hash Lock smart contract in TypeScript using ckb-js-vm and CCC SDK

scripts.build:contract: mkdir -p dist && esbuild --platform=neutral --minify --bundle --external:@ckb-js-std/bindings --target=es2022 contract/src/index.ts --outfile=dist/hash-lock.js && offckb debugger --read-file dist/hash-lock.js --bin node_modules/ckb-testtool/src/unittest/defaultScript/ckb-js-vm -- -c dist/hash-lock.bc
